data.content_ref: inline:The target explicitly substitutes recoverability for prevention, stating the protocol makes displaced evidence recoverable ‘rather than preventing displacement,’ directly contradicting the problem’s requirement of a guarantee never to silently displace completed evidence. It also supplies no causal mechanism—such as an atomic durability barrier or workspace handoff—to ensure completed evidence has actually exited the ephemeral workspace before a crash, so the evidence may reside solely there at crash time and be silently displaced by reclamation.
